description: The freeze record (CONTRACT.md §10.4; the Director's ruling on U55, 28 October 2026). schemas: the SHA-256 of each contract schema ODIN's instructions are rendered from, as a whole file. models: each model's settings, the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (§4) of its block in config/models.yaml, a date written as its ISO 8601 text. A run refuses to start if the schemas or its model's settings differ (harness/freeze.py). A model added to config/models.yaml comes to the Director first, then gets its own entry.
